findings.evidence: The callback serializes/scans under its RLock before publishing START and revokes before unlocking on any exception. The deterministic test pauses at the catch boundary against the actual worker on both sides of intent.

Canonical author submission, original visible fields, original file and report IDs, binding, executed file content, intent hash, effect and reopened path/hash are checked. Coherent changed-title/file and four cross-record changes have scoped negative coverage.

Metadata bytes, selected digest, outer response and exact options/counts are reconstructable. Replay scans the outer string but never scans the decoded action/final object. It also lacks the live nonblank final-answer check. With the original prewrite untouched, both a blank final answer and a scanner-positive synthetic identifier encoded with JSON Unicode escapes were accepted on the final ACK. Scan decoded envelopes and enforce the same nonblank rule; test post-prefix mutations with consistent outer bytes, response hash, counts and secured envelope.

Live admission installs the newly clipped timeout on the same prepared request before reserving. Refusal is recorded without consuming a POST. Both still-admitted and expired GET/POST cases inspect actual request extensions or zero starts. The new offline check has a separate numeric-domain defect N1.

The between-snapshots stage delays the actual admitted SDK file operation. The compose-error access releases and joins it after the frozen service outcome. Original timeout, terminal identity/path/bytes, independent late record, immutable response and next-request isolation assertions are reachable.

The fresh service, ACK verifier and v3 report verifier require nonempty exact bytes; absent/null/empty/mutable values are denied. The explicitly separate issued-data function does not satisfy the fresh gate.

new_findings.finding: Replay subtracts decimal representations of the binary64 clock readings, while live admission subtracts the binary64 values. With deadline 1060.2 and admitted_at 1000.1, the real author budget deadline - admitted_at - 55 is 5.100000000000023. Replay computes Decimal(1060.2)-Decimal(1000.1)-55 as 5.1 and rejects that correctly installed request timeout. This can fail valid research near the reserve boundary, or at ACK with less than 25 seconds remaining. The integer-clock F5 tests cannot catch it.
new_findings.resolution: Reconstruct the actual live clock arithmetic from lossless recorded binary64 values or use one common exact integer domain live and on replay. Add fractional real-shaped clock cases on both sides of the boundary without relaxing the time policy.
